'''2011 US Nationals Stephen Kim LS Home One: War Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: War Room|DS2-L-homeonewarroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Stephen K
* '''Deck name:''' Rogue Menace
* '''Username:''' vaith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
